ocl:
context CheckIn
inv: self.isOnline implies self.boardingPass <> null

context BoardingPass
inv: (self.seat <> null) and (self.gate <> null)

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 4 and self.weightKg <= 56

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 1 and self.weightKg <= 45

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->any(x | x.seatNo <> '') <> null) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))

context Airport
inv: (self.arrivingFlights->one(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (self.city.size() >= 5 implies self.city.substring(1, 5) = 'AB')

context Booking
inv: (self.baggages->collect(x | x.weightKg)->notEmpty()) and (self.bookingRef <> '' and self.bookingRef.size() > 0)

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null implies self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null and self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null and self.arrivalTime <> null

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->notEmpty()) and (self.registrationNo <> '' and self.registrationNo.size() > 0)

context Aircraft
inv: ((self.seats->notEmpty()) and (self.model <> null)) and (self.seats->size() >= 1)

context Flight
inv: (self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null) and (not(self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null))

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->forAll(x | x.seatNo <> '')) and (self.seats->exists(x | not(x.seatNo <> '')))

context Airline
inv: ((self.aircrafts->one(x | x.registrationNo <> '')) and (self.flights->size() >= 2 and self.flights->size() <= 3)) and (self.flights->size() < 2)

context Baggage
inv: ((self.booking.flight.departureTime <> '') and (self.weightKg.abs() <= 4)) and (not((self.booking.flight.departureTime <> '') and (self.weightKg.abs() <= 4)))

context Airline
inv: (self.flights->forAll(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (self.flights->exists(x | not(x.departureTime <> '')))

context BoardingPass
inv: (((self.seat <> null) and (self.seat.oclIsTypeOf(Seat))) and (self.checkIn.booking.createdAt <> '')) and (not(((self.seat <> null) and (self.seat.oclIsTypeOf(Seat))) and (self.checkIn.booking.createdAt <> '')))

context CheckIn
inv: (self.boardingPass <> null) and (not(self.boardingPass <> null))

context Airport
inv: (self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Airline
inv: (self.flights->exists(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (not(self.flights->exists(x | x.departureTime <> '')))

context Booking
inv: (self.baggages->exists(x | x.weightKg <= 50)) and (not(self.baggages->exists(x | x.weightKg <= 50)))

context Baggage
inv: ((self.weightKg < 44) and (self.weightKg <> null)) and (self.weightKg > 49)
